oneOf.description: Try to determine value from the conversation with the user. If `referDocumentCategories` is specified, use data derived from those documents as a fallback but use the chat to double-check if it matches the current conversation intent.
Show an input field as part of a structured input form inside the generation frame.
This value is expected to be stored as hidden metadata in the genFrame as a result of a previous generation.
The DB "valuation" table is queried for the entry that best matches all available profile and topic tags, and that entry's "value" is used.
This value is derived from other shared properties by the data agent (using dedicated "computer tools").
Directly use the genFrame placeholder text to set this value.
This value is derived from available documents that match the `documentCategories` by the data agent. If no such values are stored yet, chat with the user to fill the gaps.
